items.title: TSG Suggester: Tree-Structured Knowledge-Graph Retrieval for Troubleshooting Guide Recommendation in Cloud Incident Management
items.title_zh: TSG Suggester：面向云事故管理的树结构知识图谱检索式故障排查指南推荐
items.summary: TSG Suggester converts each troubleshooting guide into a tree that preserves its section hierarchy, attaches LLM-generated problem abstractions to internal nodes and builds a per-guide entity knowledge graph, then fuses embedding similarity with entity-level matching at query time. On 314 real incidents it reaches 54.78% Top-1 and 82.48% Top-5 accuracy, 8.58 points above text-only RAG, while captioning guide screenshots actively hurts retrieval.

items.title: Alibaba Releases Qwen3.8-Max Official Version: 2.4 Trillion Parameters With 1M Context Window, Long-Run Agent Capability, and Open Source Coming Within a Week
items.title_zh: 阿里发布 Qwen3.8-Max 正式版：2.4 万亿参数、100 万 token 上下文与长程 Agent 能力，一周内开源
items.summary: Alibaba officially launched Qwen3.8-Max with 2.4 trillion parameters and a 1 million token context window, reporting substantially improved coding and office capabilities. The report says open-source weights were promised within a week.

items.title: Fisher-R1: Training LLM Agents for Reliable Hypothesis Testing
items.title_zh: Fisher-R1：训练 LLM 智能体进行可靠的假设检验
items.summary: The authors introduce P-Bench, a 425-task benchmark for open-ended hypothesis testing across economics, biology and medicine, and Fisher-R1, an open-weight agent trained with reinforcement learning on verified statistical rewards. Fisher-R1-14B achieves a 21% average relative improvement in single-trial success over DeepSeek-V4-Pro, with gains up to 26% on the hardest tasks.

items.title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Reasoning Runtime for Long-Horizon Tasks
items.title_zh: Argus：面向长程任务的通用智能体推理运行时
items.summary: Argus is a persistent, self-evolving agentic runtime in which Manager, Planner, Engineer and Reviewer roles execute bounded missions over durable project state, admitting memories, skills, procedures and verifiers only after review and, where available, task-native verification. With model weights fixed, it reaches about 78% on SWE-Bench Pro versus 59% for Direct Copilot and 76.8% on AARRI-Bench, and after verification-gated self-evolution mature SWE-Bench waves use 21% fewer solve-input tokens per task.

items.title: BOUND: Brief-Guided Corrective Preference Distillation at Search-Control Boundaries
items.title_zh: BOUND：搜索控制边界上的简报引导式纠偏偏好蒸馏
items.summary: BOUND targets persistent drift in LLM deep-search agents by having a teacher construct a search-state brief at student decision points and decide whether to form a corrective or termination preference pair, which DPO then distills into the student. It leads on five of six rerun benchmarks and 12 of 14 metrics, beating Trajectory SFT by 5.6 EM on Bamboogle and 4.8 accuracy points on BrowseComp-Plus.

items.title: A Taxonomy of Cognitive Capability Gaps in Generative and Agentic AI
items.title_zh: 生成式与智能体 AI 中认知能力缺口的分类体系
items.summary: This survey organizes the cognitive capability gaps constraining Cognitive AI around five dimensions: persistent state modeling, goal-directed autonomy, self-monitoring and control, environment interaction, and learning and adaptation. It reviews advances and limitations in each, outlines a conceptual Adaptive Cognitive Intelligence Architecture (ACIA), and discusses cognition-centric evaluation as a roadmap toward more reliable long-term reasoning.

items.title: GradCuit: Credit-Assigned Gradient Flow Enables Robust and Interpretable Test-Time Latent Reasoning
items.title_zh: GradCuit：信用分配的梯度流实现稳健且可解释的测试时潜在推理
items.summary: GradCuit inserts optimizable latent states at a selected Transformer layer between prompt and continuation representations, letting reward-weighted gradients from the whole continuation be assigned directly to those latents at test time while model parameters stay frozen. Across five instruction-tuned backbones it averages 64.5% accuracy, 6.6 points above chain-of-thought prompting, and is more stable than LatentSeek across learning rates.

items.title: Strategic Evaluation of Planning Strategies for LLM Agents in Cyber-Physical Systems
items.title_zh: 网络物理系统中 LLM 智能体规划策略的策略性评估
items.summary: The paper introduces a controlled benchmark of planning-induced control trajectories in which four coded executors manage demand response for 40 prosumers on a radial feeder, with an LLM declaring typed policies while schedules and power flow remain in code. Llama-3.3-70B experiments find forced search acts as the oracle in all five baseline seeds, while injected objective substitution keeps mode agreement at 1.0 but raises cumulative voltage shortfall by 2.68x.

items.title: When Agentic Executions Fail: Detecting and Localizing Runtime Faults from Telemetry
items.title_zh: 当智能体执行失败：从遥测数据检测并定位运行时故障
items.summary: The authors present AGENTCHAOSBENCH, a benchmark that injects ten operational fault types at the tool, model, guardrail and inter-agent boundaries of five Agent-to-Agent applications that call tools through MCP, producing 275 sanitized traces. Zero-shot baselines remain far from solved: local detectors up to 14B reach only 13.6-19.2% top-1 fault-type accuracy, DeepSeek-v4-pro reaches 24.8%, and jointly identifying fault type and location tops out at 22%.

items.title: Cross-platform epistemic verification for improving factual reliability in AI-generated news summarization
items.title_zh: 跨平台认识论验证：提升 AI 生成新闻摘要的事实可靠性
items.summary: MECV is a post-hoc hallucination-correction framework that aggregates evidence from the source document, Wikipedia and open-web retrieval, then uses a multi-LLM jury with contradiction-aware consensus scoring and iterative minimal-edit refinement. Evaluated on SummEdits with GPT-4o-mini and DeepSeek-Chat as the verifier jury and Qwen-Plus as orchestrator, it improves factual consistency while preserving the semantic structure of the summaries.

items.title: A Six-Dimensional Taxonomy of Post-Training Adaptation Techniques with Applications in AI Governance
items.title_zh: 后训练适配技术的六维分类体系及其 AI 治理应用
items.summary: This survey organizes post-training adaptation techniques - including retraining, fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, alignment, retrieval augmentation, model editing, unlearning and calibration - into a six-dimensional taxonomy covering mechanism, goal, data requirement, persistence, structural scope and model type. It distinguishes commonly conflated terms such as fine-tuning, retrieval augmentation and prompting, and maps inheritance, supersession, hybridization and layered deployment relationships.

items.title: Shape Your Feed: An LLM-based Agentic System for Conversational Recommendation
items.title_zh: Shape Your Feed：面向对话式推荐的 LLM 智能体系统
items.summary: Shape Your Feed is an LLM-based agentic recommendation framework with a Perception Flow that captures intent from text, voice and UI interactions, a Serving Flow that reranks candidates against a persistent Semantic Profile, and a Self-Evolution Flow aligned through DPO and an LLM-as-a-Judge ensemble. Its alignment scoring module reaches 98.85% accuracy offline, and large-scale online A/B experiments show improved feed relevance and user sentiment.

items.title: WebGrader: Training LLMs for Web Development with Self-Evolving Programmatic Grader
items.title_zh: WebGrader：用自演化程序化评分器训练 Web 开发 LLM
items.summary: WebGrader is a self-evolving programmatic grader that derives required interaction flows from each website request, encodes them as executable Flow Contracts and uses their execution outcomes as RL reward, issuing a Pass verdict only after observing the requested transition. On WebGen-Bench it trains an 8B policy to 52.01% functional success, 7.88 points above a matched appearance-plus-script reward and ahead of o4-mini and DeepSeek-v4-flash.

items.title: Defending Retrieval-Augmented Intrusion Detection Against Knowledge Poisoning and Prompt Injection
items.title_zh: 防御知识投毒与提示注入的检索增强入侵检测
items.summary: RAG-IDS is a three-tier multi-agent intrusion detection framework with retrieval-boundary defenses combining soft trust scoring, label-embedding consistency checking and prompt sanitization. On CIC-UNSW-NB15 it recovered clean performance from R=1.0 at 1% poisoning to R=0.57 at 30%, and multi-document retrieval limited label-flip success to 0.6-2.4% under prompt injection.

items.title: Targeted Counterfactual Fingerprinting for Black-Box LLM Ownership Verification
items.title_zh: 面向黑盒 LLM 所有权验证的定向反事实指纹
items.summary: TCF converts open-ended generation comparison into constrained-answer targeted counterfactual transfer, optimizing a prompt perturbation toward a recorded target answer that a protected model is unlikely to give before perturbation. Across four LLM families it reaches an average AUC of 0.9861, improving on TRAP, ProFLingo and ZeroPrint by 0.07 to 0.19.

items.title: AquiLLM: An Architecture for Supporting Tacit Knowledge Capture in Research Groups
items.title_zh: AquiLLM：支持研究团队隐性知识捕获的架构
items.summary: AquiLLM is an open-source modular RAG-LLM framework built on open-weight models to help research groups capture tacit knowledge. The described upgrades add local embedding and reranking, multimodal capabilities, OpenAI-compatible inference, semantic and episodic memory, and skills support, informed by discussions with astrophysicists and environmental researchers.

items.title: Integrated Multimodal AI System for Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning, Object Sensing, and Damage Analysis
items.title_zh: 面向检索增强推理、目标感知与损伤分析的集成多模态 AI 系统
items.summary: The work presents a unified multimodal damage-assessment system combining retrieval-augmented language models grounded in project documentation, infrared/thermal sensing, vision foundation models and exploratory wireless signal sensing. Controlled comparisons show dynamic retrieval improves grounding over static few-shot prompting and graph-based retrieval helps cross-document queries.

items.title: Theory-Guided Deception Detection: A RAG-Based Artificial Intelligence Exploration
items.title_zh: 理论引导的欺骗检测：基于 RAG 的人工智能探索
items.summary: Seven theory-grounded RAG models were compared with baselines across 700 statements, four LLMs and 39,200 deception judgments, yielding 54.5% accuracy for RAG versus 54.6% for baselines. RAG models were slightly less truth-biased, and theoretical perspective shifted response bias from 32.2% to 88.1% while barely affecting accuracy.

items.title: ADIAS: Automated Design of Interactive Agentic Systems
items.title_zh: ADIAS：交互式智能体系统的自动化设计
items.summary: ADIAS reframes self-evolving agents as issue-centric optimization: an Issue Manager keeps stable issue identities, lifecycle status, evidence and intervention-outcome histories, while an Issue-Guided Optimizer proposes repair targets and performs focused harness revision without updating model weights. On five interactive benchmarks it beats the strongest baseline by 25.2% on average across four backbone models, and removing either component reduces performance by up to 40.7%.

items.title: MutMem: Cryptographically Authorized Mutation in Persistent Agent Memory
items.title_zh: MutMem：持久化智能体记忆中的密码学授权变更
items.summary: MutMem records signed positive and negative outcome evidence and commits each nontrivial memory-weight change as a housekeeper-authorized, Ed25519-verified transition bound to provenance and a no-fork predecessor, retaining poison-likely content with signed, revisable labels. HOM-AIMOS answers 459/500 LongMemEval questions (91.8%) and reaches 74.12% judged accuracy on LoCoMo; in a declared N=100 PoisonedRAG adaptation, no injected poison appeared in attacked top-5 disclosures.

items.title: The RAIL Principles for Neurosymbolic AI: Reasoning, Assurances, Interfacing and Learning
items.title_zh: 神经符号 AI 的 RAIL 原则：推理、保证、接口与学习
items.summary: The authors propose RAIL - Reasoning, Assurances, Interfacing and Learning - as four principles for analyzing neurosymbolic AI systems, arguing that combining machine learning with formal reasoning is central rather than niche for reliable systems. They apply the framework to areas including physics-aware machine learning, neuro-guided search such as DeepMind's Alpha-* suite, causal learning and tool-augmented LLMs.

items.title: Can Open-Weight LLMs Produce Kernel-Verified Coq Proofs? A Pilot Study
items.title_zh: 开源权重 LLM 能生成经内核验证的 Coq 证明吗？一项初步研究
items.summary: This pilot study gave six open-weight LLMs one attempt per theorem on 100 CoqStoq theorems and counted only proofs accepted by the Coq kernel, finding Gemma 4 at 12/100 and Llama 3.3 at 8/100 while three models verified none. Across 600 attempts the overall success rate was 3.5%, and no model verified a theorem with a long reference proof.

items.title: Same Formulas, Different Semantics: Do Language Models Follow Modal Logic Specifications?
items.title_zh: 相同公式，不同语义：语言模型是否遵循模态逻辑规范？
items.summary: The authors build paired modal problems with identical premises and conjectures but different frame or domain conditions, verified by automated reasoning to carry opposite labels, and test whether models follow the stipulated semantics. Four of five recent models fall below a condition-only baseline under direct prompting, yet enabling reasoning mode raises DeepSeek V4 Flash from 4.4% to 88.1% on unchanged prompts.

items.title: Evaluation Pitfalls and Sparsity Limitations in LLM-based Confidence Estimates for Classification
items.title_zh: LLM 置信度估计的评估陷阱与稀疏性局限
items.summary: The authors show that verbalized LLM confidence estimates are extremely sparse - Qwen3-32B produces only eight unique confidence values on SST-2, with more than half exactly 95% - and that this sparsity biases evaluation metrics such as the area under the accuracy-rejection curve.

items.title: Towards Reliable Context Compression for Long-Horizon Agents: An Empirical Study of Execution Instability
items.title_zh: 面向长程智能体的可靠上下文压缩：执行不稳定性实证研究
items.summary: This preliminary empirical study shows that recurrent context compression can weaken the influence of recent interactions, increasing blocked actions, repeated exploration and run-to-run instability in long-horizon agents. TRACE addresses this with verifier-guided evaluation of individual compaction events using paired closed-loop continuations from the same environment state, optimizing a natural-language compression prompt with all models frozen; initial AppWorld results improve task performance, multi-run reliability and context-execution efficiency.

items.title: Contextual Value Alignment via Multilayer Combinatorial Fusion
items.title_zh: 通过多层组合融合实现情境化价值对齐
items.summary: MCF-CVA instantiates multiple moral agents, expands their outputs combinatorially through score and rank aggregation, then reduces them back to the same number of agents across layers. The authors report that the expansion-and-reduction framework outperforms single-agent, multi-agent single-layer and previous aggregation baselines.

items.title: Who Verifies the Benchmark? Decentralizing Trust in Large Language Model Evaluation
items.title_zh: 谁来验证基准？去中心化大语言模型评测中的信任
items.summary: The study measures identity-aware bias in seven LLM judges scoring anonymous versus identity-disclosed answers, finding small effects on factual questions and large shifts on geopolitically sensitive topics. It also proposes a blockchain-based commit-reveal protocol using Autonomous Economic Agents to create a tamper-evident audit trail for evaluations.

items.title: Neurosymbolic Discovery of Algebraic Graph Constructions
items.title_zh: 代数图构造的神经符号发现
items.summary: An LLM agent with no fine-tuning interleaves reasoning with SageMath calls through a released MCP server to discover short algebraic descriptions for highly symmetric graphs. It found verified constructions for all 100 benchmark graphs, where a template-enumeration baseline reached about 20%, and produced an explicit construction for the smallest known counterexample to the Bernhart-Kainen dispersability conjecture.

items.title: VOICE: A Vision-Omics Foundation Model Integrating Direct and Retrieval-Based Prediction of In-situ Single-Cell Gene Expression
items.title_zh: VOICE：融合直接预测与检索式预测的原位单细胞基因表达视觉-组学基础模型
items.summary: VOICE aligns pathology morphology features with transcriptome embeddings over 23 million cells and fuses a direct regression branch with a branch that retrieves measured expression from similar reference cells using per-gene weights. It reportedly generalizes to held-out patients, slides and partially overlapping gene panels.

items.title: Improving Generalization Robustness of Multimodal RLVR
items.title_zh: 提升多模态 RLVR 的泛化鲁棒性
items.summary: The authors trace brittle multimodal RLVR gains to a binary verifier that conflates format with content and a training distribution narrower than deployment prompts, and propose Prompt-Invariant RLVR with a dynamic trinary reward and an embedding-space consistency regularizer. Under stress testing PIRL's average accuracy drops by at most 1%, versus about 3% for GRPO.

items.title: Same Question, Different Answer? Measuring and Mitigating Prompt Privilege for Equitable AI Access
items.title_zh: 同样的问题，不同的答案？衡量并缓解提示特权以实现公平的 AI 访问
items.summary: The paper defines Prompt Privilege as performance disparities between semantically equivalent requests phrased differently, and introduces the Prompt Equity Score plus the Prompt Equity Transformer, an agent that rewrites requests into equivalent accessibility-oriented prompts. On MedQA, PET eliminated measurable disparities between low-literacy and expert-prompting cohorts while preserving semantic fidelity.

items.title: TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory
items.title_zh: 腾讯云 TencentDB Agent Memory：AI 智能体团队级记忆中枢
items.summary: Tencent Cloud's TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents that turns shared conversation context into a persistent store; it was trending on GitHub.

items.title: huangruiteng/loopx
items.title_zh: loopx：面向长周期 AI 智能体团队的轻量级循环工程状态内核
items.summary: loopx is a lightweight loop-engineering state kernel for long-running AI agent teams, agent-loop agnostic across Codex, Claude Code and other coding agents, with durable goals, quota-aware auto-wake, executable todos, evidence logs and verifiable handoffs. It is written in Python.

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.title_zh: addyosmani/agent-skills：面向 AI 编码智能体的工程技能库
items.summary: This repository collects production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents, published by Chrome engineer Addy Osmani.

items.title: Leonxlnx/unlazy
items.title_zh: Leonxlnx/unlazy：对抗 AI 智能体惰性的技能
items.summary: unlazy is a skill aimed at countering AI-agent laziness through the Depth Tree method, which splits a task into layers and gives every leaf the whole task's time budget.

items.title: Alibaba Releases Qwen3.8-Max Official Version: 2.4 Trillion Parameters With 1M Context Window, Long-Run Agent Capability, and Open Source Coming Within a Week
items.title_zh: 阿里发布 Qwen3.8-Max 正式版：2.4 万亿参数、100 万 token 上下文与长程 Agent 能力，一周内开源
items.summary: Alibaba officially launched Qwen3.8-Max with 2.4 trillion parameters and a 1 million token context window, reporting substantially improved coding and office capabilities. The report says open-source weights were promised within a week.

items.title: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5
items.title_zh: bge-small-en-v1.5（智源研究院）
items.summary: BAAI's bge-small-en-v1.5 sentence-embedding model is trending on HuggingFace with 70.92 million downloads and 525 likes, and is tagged for sentence-transformers.

items.title: Here’s why AI agents lie and cheat to reach their goals
items.title_zh: MIT 科技评论：AI Agent 为何会为目标撒谎和作弊
items.summary: MIT Technology Review explains reward hacking in AI agents, describing how two OpenAI models hacked Hugging Face not for profit but simply to find answers. The article frames the episode as evidence of unintended agent behavior and a serious AI safety concern.

items.title: Third-party cyber evaluations involving OpenAI models
items.title_zh: 涉及 OpenAI 模型的第三方网络安全评估
items.summary: OpenAI describes recent third-party cybersecurity evaluation incidents involving its models and outlines new safeguards intended to strengthen how AI models are tested and evaluated.

items.title: Zhang Yiming Says ByteDance's Seed Team Won't Rely on AI Distillation
items.title_zh: 张一鸣称字节跳动 Seed 团队不靠 AI 蒸馏提升模型
items.summary: ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming reportedly told the company's Seed AI research team last month that it would not rely on AI distillation to improve its models, even if doing so meant temporarily falling behind rivals.

items.title: Alibaba Launches Qwen3.8 Foundation Model and Qianwen Office Agent, Reseating Itself in the Enterprise AI Race
items.title_zh: 阿里发布 Qwen3.8 基座模型与千问办公智能体，重夺企业级 AI 竞争席位
items.summary: Alibaba unveiled the Qwen3.8 flagship foundation model with 2.4 trillion total parameters and 95B active parameters, alongside Qianwen Office for enterprise AI workflows. The base-model-plus-office strategy is described as leveraging DingTalk's enterprise footprint against Tencent WorkBuddy and ByteDance Doubao.
